Join Kardome

Build the Voice AI

Voice is the interface of the future. That’s why we developed Voice UI that hears and understands like people do. It makes voice UI work as it should, providing frustration-free voice experiences anywhere, anytime for smart devices that people love to use.

Kardome gives smart devices the ability to hear and localize sound sources, identify who’s speaking, and understand what they mean in context, for natural, intuitive voice interactions that perform reliably in the most complex environments: Powered by our Spatial Hearing AI and Cognition AI technologies.

Where Every Voice Shapes the Signal

Together, we’re building the intelligence that makes Voice UI truly listen, understand, and connect.

Impact First

Every team member contributes directly to the intelligence behind our AI. From concept to deployment, your work shapes how millions will interact with technology. We move quickly, learn constantly, and deliver results that redefine what AI can do.

Own the Clarity

At Kardome, ownership means taking full responsibility for the entire chain of communication, from our first line of code to the final customer experience.

Every team member at Kardome acts on behalf of the whole company and is empowered to identify a problem, bridge a gap, or fix a bug, even when it's outside their direct scope. We never say, "that's not my job."

Open Collaboration

We keep hierarchy light and communication open.

You’ll have direct access to leadership, visibility into decision-making, and the freedom to experiment.

We believe great ideas thrive where transparency and trust are the norm.

Growth Mindset

AI doesn’t stand still — and neither do we.

We invest in your growth through ongoing learning, mentorship, and the opportunity to explore new frontiers in spatial hearing and cognitive AI.

Here, mastery is never final — it’s a journey we take together.

Shape the Future of Voice AI.
